source_references: Decision Register 5.2 CTR-USG-001 row: decimal money
freeze_boundary: Draft only. Materializes exactly OB-004's six usage dimensions and its attribution requirement, and carries money and quantity as decimal STRINGS because MOD-130 forbids floating-point money. The provider price list, the conversion between currencies, the reconciliation algorithm (OB-008) and the safe metric-label set (OB-006) are NOT inferred here. `metric_labels` was REMOVED. Decision Register 5.2 assigns bounded cardinality to the CTR-OBS-001 row, not to this one, and CTR-OBS-001 already implements it in sli_tags. Carrying it here was the exact inverse of the 'right row, wrong column' error CTR-OBS-001 itself records -- right column, wrong row. Independent review found it.
untestable_by_fixture: OB-008 requires missing and duplicate usage to be DETECTED against provider statements, and OB-004 requires attribution to be complete across a whole workflow. Both are properties of a ledger over many events reconciled against an external statement; a single event document cannot demonstrate either. They need a reconciliation harness and a provider fixture before freeze.
untestable_by_schema: That a cost figure is ARITHMETICALLY correct for its quantity. The schema can require a decimal string with an explicit scale; it cannot check that 1450 tokens at a given rate equals the amount claimed. That is OB-008's job.
